About Qorelo
Almost every large company in the DACH region is facing the same task: the transformation to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point — nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.
That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI layer for S/4HANA transformation: we read code, processes and documentation, make the existing landscape transparent, and deliver the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards — including in day-to-day operations, long after the system integrators have moved on.
We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz, and we sell to enterprise customers across DACH as well as to selected SAP consultancies who use Qorelo in their own client projects.

You will be one of the first sellers on the team, and you own your accounts end to end — from first touch to signature. We have a product with a clear business case, a defined target market, a pricing model that holds up, and a sales playbook you can run from day one. What we need is someone who turns that into pipeline and revenue.
You will work closely with the Head of Sales, as well as with product and our engineers, and you will have a direct line to the people who build what you sell.
What you'll own
The full sales cycle. You build your own pipeline, qualify, run discovery and demos, drive the Proof of Value and negotiate the close — no SDR teeing it up for you, no handover to a closing team.
Selling to decision makers. CIOs, Heads of SAP, transformation leads and procurement — you get them into the same room.
MEDDICC as your sales motion.

You quantify the business case in the customer's own numbers (Metrics), get to the Economic buyer instead of stopping at the sponsor, understand the Decision criteria and the Decision process including procurement, security and works council, map the Paper process early, qualify the Identified pain hard enough to know whether the deal is real, build a Champion who sells internally when you are not in the room, and position against the Competition — including the customer's option to do nothing.
Honest qualification. MEDDICC is how we forecast, not paperwork. Gaps in your deal are visible in the CRM, and walking away from a deal that will not close is a good outcome, not a failure.
Technical sales cycles. You steer fit-to-standard Proof of Value engagements, security and data protection reviews, and questions around on-premise and cloud deployment together with our team.
Negotiating and closing. Multi-year agreements, framework contracts, ramp deals, procurement rounds — you hold the line on value instead of discounting your way to a signature.
A forecast we can plan on. You keep Attio, our CRM, clean and current, and your forecast holds up.
What you need
Several years of SaaS sales experience selling to enterprise customers with multi-month sales cycles
A demonstrable track record of not just hitting but exceeding ambitious revenue targets — you can walk us through your numbers for the past few years
Ownership mentality: you run the full sales cycle from first outreach to signed contract
Confident negotiation at executive level in German and English (German at native level)
Experience selling AI products and the ability to translate technical value into a business case that survives a CFO review
You use AI tools in your day-to-day sales work — research, prep, outreach, follow-up — and you are curious about what they can take off your plate next

You have been an early sales hire at a fast-growing startup and want that again, with more ownership
You have an existing network among IT decision makers in DACH

Eine strategisch bedeutsame Rolle mit direktem Einfluss auf das Unternehmenswachstum
Klare Ziele, volle Autonomie in der Ausführung – kein Mikromanagement

Du gestaltest – nicht nur mit. Du gestaltest, wie es wird.
Implico ist kein fertig gebautes Konstrukt, das auf einen weiteren Vertriebsmitarbeiter wartet. Diese Rolle ist eine der ersten ihrer Art – du definierst mit, wie wir in den Prozessindustrien wahrgenommen werden, wie wir co-sellen, wie wir skalieren. Was du heute aufbaust, bleibt. Dein Fingerabdruck ist sichtbar – in der Kundenbasis, in der Marktpositionierung, in der Art, wie das Team in zwei Jahren arbeitet. Das ist kein Job. Das ist ein Gestaltungsauftrag.
Das Team – kein Versprechen, sondern eine Einladung.
"Tolles Team" steht in jeder Stellenanzeige. Das überspringst du längst. Deshalb sagen wir es anders: Schau dir an, mit wem du zusammenarbeiten würdest. Mark, Maurice, Anna, Thales, Selina und mehr. Menschen, die nicht wegen des Titels hier sind. Die morgens mit echtem Interesse an ihre Arbeit gehen.

Die füreinander einspringen, ohne dass jemand fragen muss. Die über ihre Themen sprechen, als wären es ihre eigenen Projekte – weil sie es sind. Keine perfekte Hochglanz-Kultur. Wenn du in den letzten Jahren bewiesen hast, dass du im SAP-Umfeld neue Märkte erschließt und Abschlüsse bringst dann freuen wir uns auf ein erstes, offenes Gespräch.  Kein langes Anschreiben. Zeig uns deinen Track Record – der Rest ergibt sich.

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need.

From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.
We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation.
We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do.
Job Description
What is the purpose of this Role?
The successful candidate will be responsible for new business sales within Elavon ’s Enterprise Retail vertical, focusing on key merchants across the UK. As an individual contributor, you will be responsible for the entire sales journey from initial prospecting to the relationship manager hand-off, whilst achieving your revenue goals and supporting the growth of the retail vertical across Europe.
Who does this Role report to?
Head of Sales Enterprise Retail Europe.
Fitness & Probity
This role is a ‘controlled function’ as defined by the Central Bank Reform Act 2010 Regulations 2011.
Role accountability - what are you expected to do?
Understand the payments landscape, the competitive environment and our ideal customer fit
Identify new business opportunities and communicate Elavon ’s value proposition based on the enterprise merchants’ needs
Work closely with our relationship managers and the partnership team to explore expansion opportunities across new territories
Navigate complex sales cycles and collaborate effectively with senior enterprise executives to negotiate and close high value deals
Manage external and internal relationships with multiple stakeholders
Establish and maintain an effective referral network
Achieve company revenue targets

Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales and revenue targets
5+ years of sales experience selling payments and complex financial service solutions to large merchants in the UK
Clear focus on self-generated new business acquisition (hunter mindset), from prospecting through close
Demonstrated experience in managing complex deal cycles and multiple projects independently
To build relationships with C-Suite executives and engage multiple stakeholders within the decision-making cycle
To be a strategic negotiator and an influential and highly effective communicator
To maintain high ethical standards; gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity and authenticity
A native or fluent English speaker

s.h: Competencies for your Role - how are you expected to behave?
s.t:
1. Drive for Results
Pursues goals with energy and perseverance; rarely gives up before succeeding; works to overcome barriers and challenges in order to produce desired results; can be counted on to achieve or surpass goals; consistently a top performer among peer group.
2. Collaboration
Develops good working relationships with others; recognizes and values differences; encourages an inclusive collaborative environment and open dialogue; puts team’s goals ahead of personal agendas; shares information openly and transparently; openly supports team members and their efforts.
3. Agility & Innovation
Demonstrate flexibility in dealing with fast-changing priorities, and different or challenging situations. Help others to continuously improve and achieve results. Explore multiple solutions to overcome obstacles. Anticipate future needs that may affect the team or organization.
4. Inclusion
Build a culture of equity and inclusion in which diverse ideas, talent and perspectives are welcomed and encouraged.
5. Risk Management
Appropriately identify and manage risks, in compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, and with Company Policy.
6. Ethics and Trust
Maintain high ethical standards; gain the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity and authenticity. Conducts him or herself honestly and ethically; adheres to a core set of values and standards appropriate to the situation and acts; accordingly, is consistent in own words and actions; inspires trust and respect by dealing openly with people; keeps confidences and admits mistakes.
Control Function Disclosure
This role has been identified as Controlled Function (“CF 4”) under the CBI Regulations. Accordingly, the Company must be satisfied on reasonable grounds that the role holder complies at all times with the requirements of:
a) the CBI’s Fitness and Probity Regime and the Conduct Standards (as applicable to the role).
Applicants (and upon joining the Company, employees) agree to permit the Company (or its agents) to conduct such due diligence as it deems necessary to satisfy itself on reasonable grounds that you comply with the aforementioned requirements (as applicable to the role) and that you will provide the Company with all information and/or documentation relating to your qualifications, experience, employment history, financial soundness and other interests that the Company requests for that purpose.
It is the individual responsibility of every employee to maintain a current awareness and understanding of and to fully comply with U.S. Bank’s “Code of Ethics”. Each employee is also expected to maintain an awareness of the laws, regulations, internal policies and procedures that are appropriate for the position.
Elavon supports Equal Opportunity and is regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland.
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.
This role is designated as home-based remote.
Accessibility
We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need adjustments at any stage of the application or hiring process, please contact your recruiter for guidance and support.
Total Rewards
U.S. Bank is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices in line with local regulatory and legal requirements. Our total rewards approach is designed to attract, retain, and support top talent while ensuring equal pay for work of equal value.

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
We’re here to give power to the patient.
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting . We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Zocdoc’s goal is to become the scheduling layer for healthcare, making it easier for patients to find and access the care they need. At the heart of that goal are our integrations. They connect Zocdoc to the systems our customers use every day and make it possible for patients to see accurate availability and book care. For our Enterprise customers, integrations are not just a technical requirement. They are a core part of why customers choose Zocdoc and how they get value from the platform.
As an Enterprise Sales Manager, Integrations, you’ll lead the Technical Implementation Specialist team responsible for bringing those integrations to life for our largest and most complex customers. Your team owns the technical implementation experience from discovery through launch, making sure integrations are designed correctly, move with urgency, and support the customer’s goals.
You will hire, train, develop, and retain top talent while continuing to raise both the technical and commercial capabilities of the team. You will coach your team to build trust quickly, navigate complex customer environments, clearly communicate technical requirements, and keep implementations moving forward.
You will create a culture of accountability, urgency, and ownership, with a strong focus on hitting targets around implementation speed, quality, customer adoption, and provider growth. You will be responsible not just for the results of the team, but for building a team that continues to get better over time and consistently delivers a high-quality implementation experience for our customers.
You’ll Enjoy This Role If You…
Ambitious and motivated by impact. You’re excited to lead a team that drives business-critical outcomes and you’re never satisfied with simply meeting targets—you look for ways to exceed them.
Passionate about people development. You gain personal satisfaction from helping others grow, mentoring individual contributors, and building a culture of accountability and trust.
Technically curious. You love connecting commercial and technical dots and bridging the gap between client needs and seamless product integration.
Resilient and resourceful. You lead calmly through ambiguity and make high-quality decisions even when information is incomplete.
Collaborative and relationship-driven. You know how to align diverse internal stakeholders toward shared goals, especially across sales, product, implementation, engineering, and integration teams.

Leading, coaching, and developing a team of Technical Implementation Specialists to deliver high-quality, timely, and reliable enterprise integrations.
Identifying integration risks, capacity constraints, and performance gaps early, then taking action to address them.
Identifying gaps in process, tooling, training, and content, then partnering with the right teams to close them.
Using data to inform prioritization, capacity planning, coaching plans, and continuous improvement.
Creating a culture of ownership, continuous learning, and high performance across the TIS team.
Supporting high-stakes client and internal escalations while maintaining trust, urgency, and accountability.
You’ll Be Successful in This Role If You Have…
3+ years of experience leading teams, ideally in technical implementation, enterprise integrations, customer success, or a related function.
Experience leading teams that implement technical products or support complex enterprise customers.
The ability to bridge technical, commercial, and customer needs, ideally in healthcare technology or enterprise software.
Familiarity with EHR/EMR systems and healthcare workflows preferred.
A data-driven approach to diagnosing performance gaps, prioritizing work, managing capacity, and identifying opportunities for improvement.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to adapt your message for individual contributors, teams, clients, cross-functional partners, and senior leaders.
The ability to lead through technical and client-facing escalations while maintaining trust, urgency, and accountability

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.
As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.
As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

We’re currently hiring Senior Account Executives across multiple Inspira Education Group brands.
We’re looking for a driven, entrepreneurial Senior Account Executive with a strong ownership mindset. Someone who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment and is eager to help students achieve their academic dreams. You’ll play a key role in driving revenue growth through inbound sales, while also helping to build and refine the systems and processes that will allow our sales function to scale in the future.
This is one of the most impactful roles at Inspira. As the first point of contact for parents and students exploring our programs, you’ll set the tone for their entire experience. The trust, empathy, and expertise you bring to these conversations often become the deciding factors in their choice to work with us. You’ll guide them through one of the most meaningful decisions of their lives- investing in their education and future success.

Lead consultative intro calls (inbound) with parents and students to understand their goals, explain the admissions process, and recommend the right Inspira programs and packages based on their needs
Own the relationship with prospective students and families from first touch through enrollment by building trust, offering guidance, and ensuring a smooth and positive experience throughout their journey
Follow up strategically and consistently to stay connected with prospects, anticipate questions or concerns, and help them confidently decide to partner with Inspira
Experiment and innovate—test new scripts, refine messaging, and explore creative follow-up strategies to maximize conversion rates and continuously improve the enrollment experience
Close deals across a range of programs and services, meeting or exceeding monthly and quarterly sales goals
Collaborate cross-functionally with the marketing, counseling, and finance teams to ensure seamless handoffs, strong alignment, and an exceptional customer experience
Stay informed on competitor offerings and market trends; provide real-time feedback to founders and leadership to shape product, pricing, and go-to-market strategy
Leverage HubSpot CRM to manage the full sales cycle—tracking leads, logging communications, creating email templates, forecasting revenue, and maintaining data integrity across all stages
Forecast enrollments accurately by managing deal stages, values, and close dates in HubSpot
Support onboarding and customer success for newly enrolled students to ensure a strong start and high satisfaction

3–5 years of experience in inbound sales within a service-oriented or consultative environment, ideally with sales cycles under 2–3 months
Proven success selling premium or high-value service packages (ACV $5,000+), with a track record of exceeding targets and delivering exceptional client experiences
Excellent communication skills. You’re confident presenting, writing, and speaking with clarity, empathy, and professionalism
Strong CRM proficiency, preferably in HubSpot (or similar tools), with a knack for maintaining clean data and using systems to drive performance
Comfort with data and reporting, including experience using Excel or Google Sheets to build and interpret dashboards
Nice to Have: Prior experience in education, admissions, or academic consulting sales
What We Value
As a fast-growing startup, every team member plays a pivotal role in shaping our culture and driving our success. At Inspira, we’re looking for people who embody these core values:
Winning Attitude: You find a way to succeed. You dig deeper to understand the “why” behind a no, and you don’t stop until you’ve found a solution
Curiosity: You constantly push yourself to learn, experiment, and improve. You’re open to new ideas and you see setbacks as opportunities to grow
Genuine Relationships: You lead with empathy and integrity. Parents and students trust us with one of the most important decisions of their lives, and you honor that by building authentic, human connections
Smart and Hard Work: You combine awareness and judgment with effort and discipline. You know when to think strategically and when to roll up your sleeves
Humility and Teamwork: You celebrate collective success over individual wins. You welcome feedback, learn from mistakes, and support those around you

Amazing people with a great vision and values

Your work directly impacts the lives and careers of students across the globe

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

As a Scale Growth Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll own a portfolio of roughly 6-8 of our most strategic and fastest-scaling AI-native startup customers, driving expansion and retention by helping them harness the transformative potential of safe, frontier AI.

These are companies that build on Anthropic's models and are now scaling quickly — your job is to grow with them.

You'll leverage your consultative sales expertise to expand revenue across complex, multi-stakeholder accounts while becoming a trusted strategic advisor to founders and executive teams, helping them expand their AI capabilities and unlock new use cases.

Working closely with GTM, Applied AI, product, and marketing teams, you'll identify expansion opportunities while ensuring our customers get maximum value from Anthropic's solutions.
The ideal candidate will combine strong commercial acumen with executive relationship management skills, focusing on growing large accounts through strategic expansion while maintaining high retention rates in a competitive market. By driving expanded deployment of Anthropic's products at the companies defining what AI-native looks like, you will help them scale their AI capabilities while advancing its safe and ethical development.

Drive revenue growth through strategic account expansion and renewals across a focused portfolio (~6-8) of Anthropic's largest AI-native startup customers. Own the full sales cycle for upsell and renewal opportunities while maintaining strong retention rates
Build and maintain trusted relationships with founders, board members, and executive stakeholders, as well as the technical leaders (CTO, VP Engineering, Head of AI) who own model decisions
Lead strategic account planning including executive business reviews, health checks, usage and forecast reviews, and renewal negotiations
Partner with customers to identify new use cases, workloads, and products that expand their AI capabilities with Anthropic
Navigate complex commercial conversations — multi-stakeholder deals, evolving usage patterns, and competitive evaluations — in partnership with Applied AI and product teams
Serve as the voice of the customer by gathering feedback and conveying market needs to inform our product roadmap
Develop and execute account strategies that align Anthropic's solutions with customer business objectives
Proactively identify and mitigate retention and competitive risks while maintaining high customer satisfaction

11+ years of experience in sales or account management roles, with a proven track record of growing large, complex accounts and exceeding retention and expansion targets
Success as a strategic business advisor to founders and executives, deeply understanding fast-scaling startup needs and creating solutions that align with their vision
Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, working with technical stakeholders, and negotiating strategic deals
Strong presentation and communication skills with ability to build relationships across all customer levels, from ICs to founders and C-level executives
Analytical approach to understanding customer needs and usage combined with creative solutions to drive expansion
A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality
Passion for emerging technologies like AI, with interest in ensuring they are developed safely and responsibly
Experience running executive business reviews and managing executive relationships
Track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota in fast-paced environments

Experience selling or expanding usage- or consumption-based API, infrastructure, or developer-platform products
Experience selling to technical founders, CTOs, and engineering leaders at AI-native or developer-first companies
Fluency in the LLM/AI market — model providers, capabilities, pricing models, and how AI-native companies evaluate and switch between them
Experience structuring larger commercial agreements (usage commitments, multi-year terms, enterprise contract terms) with fast-growing customers

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains.

Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To make every leader better. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable insights and impactful moments.
We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
Our vision is to transform presentations, meetings and lectures by turning passive audiences into engaged contributors. We make this possible through our interactive presentation platform where the traditional presentation monologue becomes an inclusive dialogue. We believe in the power of together and that the most successful leaders listen to be heard.
With Mentimeter, users become the best presenter they can be. Meetings become more productive, participants learn more and have fun whilst doing it.
We have more than 300 million users and customers worldwide, on our way of making the world a better place, one presentation at a time.
As an Account Manager, you will lead the expansion of our existing Enterprise customers by focusing on revenue growth through renewals and up-sales while serving as a trusted adviser to our customers.
We expect you to have an entrepreneurial tempo with the main focus on commercial initiatives to drive revenue growth among our Enterprise customers. We are looking for someone who can create long-term and strategic relationships with out customers.
We use the theory of Predictable Revenue, and reference Dropbox and Slack when we see the future of Mentimeter. Mentimeter is a service that is loved globally and our growth has been almost 100% organic. Sales are currently growing over 10% per month and you will be the driving force to accelerate that growth even further.

Full commercial ownership of our current enterprise customers
Drive revenue growth by building a strong pipeline and expanding our customers. Your success is measured on Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
Manage a continuous pipeline for new expansion and up-sell opportunities
Build long-term, strategic relationships with customers all over North America
Ownership of renewals of ongoing agreements in order to prevent churn
Ability to assess business opportunities and use data in order to support decision-making towards customers
Develop a strategy for best-in-class scalable customer expansion and customer success
Collaborate together with Customer Success Managers on strategic enterprise customers in addition to working with other sales roles on a day to day basis
Work closely with the marketing and product team by serving as the voice of your customers as well as listening to the market needs

We strongly believe in the power of togetherness, and we put a lot of effort into collaboration, teamwork and helping each other whenever needed. We believe that every part of Mentimeter, from Sales Development Representatives and Account Executives to Frontend Developers and Marketing Managers contributes equally to our continued success.

To foster and emphasize this culture and way of working, we apply a non-commission based salary model in our sales roles, which has proven to be very successful and appreciated across the team. The salary band for this role ranges anywhere from $75,000 - $100,000 CAD depending on your level of experience.

s.h: You can also read about our benefits and perks here .
s.t:
What Mentimeter can offer
At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues.

We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter.

Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Once a year we also relocate to exciting places all over the world like Merida & Buenos Aires for our Toronto colleagues, cities in Europe (for our Stockholm colleagues), and cities in APAC (for our Sydney colleagues), paid for by us of course. Meet Attribute™ : AI tokenomics without tags, SDKs, or code changes. A lightweight eBPF sensor installs in 15 minutes and starts producing per-customer, per-feature, and per-agent token economics the same day. No instrumentation. No tagging policy. No engineering lift.
The problem it solves is real and measurable. In DoiT's survey of 500 finance and technology leaders, only 15% said they could calculate AI ROI without significant bottlenecks — and 79% experienced AI-related cost overruns in the past 12 months. AI spend is tripling. Visibility isn't keeping up. Attribute™ fixes that, at the kernel level, with nothing to instrument.

If you've ever wanted to be employee number something-small on a product that actually moves the category, this is that role.
Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state — from planning to production.
Delivering Cloud Intelligence™, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.

An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. 700 people, 40+ countries, zero offices. The best idea wins regardless of timezone.
The Opportunity
This is a sales role on Attribute™ - a brand-new product line inside DoiT that solves one of the hardest unsolved problems in FinOps: knowing exactly where AI money is actually being spent.
Until now, attributing AI spend meant instrumenting it. Engineering teams wrapped every model call in an SDK, threaded metadata through every request, or enforced tagging standards that shared GPUs and single-account model APIs were defeated by design. Attribute™ takes the opposite approach: it measures what actually runs.

The sensor observes real consumption at the OS kernel and maps every unit of GPU, CPU, API call, memory, network, and I/O back to the process, container, pod, and request responsible — including outbound calls to Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, and AWS Bedrock. Cached, reasoning, input, and output tokens are split automatically.

The result is token economics that holds up to audit, with zero engineering effort to produce or maintain.

Full-Cycle Sales Management: Run efficient, full-cycle sales processes across a diverse prospect portfolio with varying deal sizes and cycle lengths. Qualify rigorously, engage the right stakeholders, apply appropriate urgency, and close new logo deals with confidence — whether the cycle takes two weeks or six months.
Compelling Value Creation: Articulate clear, outcome-linked value propositions for Cloudflare's platform, tailored to the specific context and priorities of each prospect. Post-Close Positioning: Ensure newly closed customers are set up for success on the Cloudflare platform and positioned for long-term growth. Identify early expansion signals and hand off cleanly — then focus on the next new logo.
Pipeline Management & Forecasting: Maintain a healthy, accurate new logo pipeline and deliver reliable, insight-driven forecast calls to sales leadership. Use AI-powered pipeline intelligence tools to keep your view of the business current, honest, and actionable.
Market Insight & Team Contribution: Share field intelligence from the digital-native ecosystem openly with the wider team. Contribute to Cloudflare's understanding of how this segment builds, buys, and scales — and help the organisation stay relevant and competitive in a fast-moving market.

Business Development Manager, APAC (China Clients)
EBANX is looking for a Business Development Manager to drive net-new merchant acquisition across the China commercial organization, with a focus on China-headquartered companies expanding into Latin America, Southeast Asia, Middle East & Africa, India and other growth markets that Ebanx is about to operate.

This is a pure hunter role — you will be responsible for opening doors, building pipeline from scratch, and closing first contracts with strategic and enterprise-tier merchants across high-priority verticals.
The China BD pipeline is growing fast, but the next wave of growth depends on new deals opened today. You will be the engine of that next wave. To succeed here, you need the ability to identify the right account, map complex internal stakeholder structures across merchant organizations, and close deals that span multiple countries and product lines simultaneously.

Build and manage a net-new merchant pipeline across target verticals — Gaming, Online Retail, Mobility, SaaS, Streaming, and Entertainment — with a focus on accounts that have a clear multi-market expansion thesis.
Prospect, qualify, and advance deals from first contact through signed contract, with rigorous stage discipline tracked in Salesforce.
Navigate multi-stakeholder merchant structures: many target accounts (e.g. Chinese companies expanding into LATAM) require parallel engagement with China HQ, regional business teams, local legal/finance, and treasury — you will map and manage all of them.
Own deal strategy for complex, multi-country opportunities, including phased go-live approaches (e.g. launching Argentina first while tax assessments clear in CL/CO/PE), and work cross-functionally with EBANX Legal, Tax, Compliance, and Product to unblock deals.
Develop territory and vertical strategies identifying where EBANX has the strongest competitive angle and where stronger pipeline coverage is still needed — particularly in MEA, SEA, and India.
Collaborate with Ebanx country and regional teams to facilitate introductions between merchant China headquarters and local subsidiary stakeholders that BD cannot access directly.
Maintain accurate pipeline forecasting in Salesforce, including honest probability assessments and clear next actions for each deal stage.
Collaborate closely with the internal Key Account Management team to have warm hand-overs for accounts that need to be transferred after the initial period, with a full deal brief, relationship map, and activation plan — and monitor post-signing go-live to ensure committed GP materializes.

Mandarin as a native language; fluent English.
7+ years in business development or new logo sales, with a demonstrated track record of closing net-new enterprise accounts — not just managing existing portfolios.
Deep knowledge of the payments landscape: processing flows, card schemes, local alternative payment methods, chargeback and fraud dynamics, and how these differ across LATAM, SEA, MEA, and India.
Proven experience managing deals with long, complex cycles — multi-department merchant approvals, multi-country tax and regulatory assessments, and incumbent displacement situations.
Comfortable working independently on greenfield accounts: you can build a relationship from zero, develop a commercial thesis, and drive to close without a warm handoff.
Strong analytical mindset: you use data to prioritize your pipeline, build a business case, and challenge assumptions — internally and externally.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or related field.
Overseas living or working experience strongly preferred — comfort navigating cross-cultural and cross-timezone commercial dynamics is essential.
Flexible working hour to accommodate China, LATAM, SEA, and MEA time zone overlap.

s.h: What we're looking for beyond the resume
s.t:
Hunter mentality with strategic depth. You are energized by opening new accounts and building pipeline from scratch. But you also understand that the biggest deals — multi-country, multi-year — require a thoughtful, multi-stakeholder strategy, not just activity volume. You know when to push and when to play a longer game.
Ability to drive deals through blockers, such as legal bandwidth, KYM friction, multi-department business case review loops, and taxation assessments across markets. You have encountered these before, and you know how to unstick them — either by escalating internally or by restructuring the commercial approach.
Geographic range and regional curiosity. LATAM is the core market, but the next phase of Ebanx BD growth runs through new Growth markets like MEA, SEA, and India. You are genuinely curious about these markets, can build a thesis for why a specific merchant should expand there, and are comfortable prospecting in regions where EBANX is less established.
Vertical credibility in at least two of: Gaming, Online Retail, Mobility, SaaS, Streaming, or Entertainment. You understand the business model, unit economics, seasonal dynamics, and payment complexity specific to those verticals — and can translate that into a relevant commercial pitch.
Resilience and composure in ambiguity. Deals stall. Merchants deprioritize markets. Tax assessments take longer than expected. You stay productive under uncertainty and know how to maintain momentum without losing the relationship.
Pipeline discipline. You treat Salesforce as a source of truth, not a formality. Your stage assessments are honest, your next actions are specific, and your forecasts reflect reality.
Ownership through activation. You don't consider a deal done at contract signing. You track post-signing integration timelines and volume migration, and escalate proactively if a signed account isn't converting — because committed GP that doesn't activate is a miss.

The Strategic Account Manager holds a pivotal position within the NA Sales department, tasked with overseeing and expanding the relationships with our largest partners.

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

About Arize
AI is rapidly transforming the world. As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems. That’s where we come in. Arize AI is the leading AI & Agent Engineering observability and evaluation platform , empowering AI engineers to ship high-performing, reliable agents and applications. From first prototype to production scale, Arize AX unifies build, test, and run in a single workspace—so teams can ship faster with confidence.
We’re a Series C company backed by top-tier investors,with over $135M in funding and a rapidly growing customer base of 150+ leading enterprises and Fortune 500 companies. Customers like , Uber, Siemens, and PepsiCo leverage Arize to deliver AI that works.
The Opportunity
We're hiring a Growth Account Executive to own renewals and expansion across our SMB book of business. This is a high-velocity, transactional seat. You'll run a large number of deals at once, work them fast, and be measured on retention and net expansion.

This is distinct from our enterprise expansion team, who run deep strategic motions on a small set of accounts. Here, the game is speed, coverage, and creativity - spotting the usage signal that means a customer is ready to grow, getting to the right person, and closing it in weeks rather than quarters.

If you want a seat where you control your own outcomes, see the direct impact of your hustle, and get to sell a technical product to smart buyers in one of the fastest-moving categories in software, this is it.

Own a book of renewals end to end — forecast, negotiate, and close on time, protecting revenue and pushing for uplift where the value is there.
Drive mid-term expansion. Don't wait for the renewal date. Find, build, and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities throughout the contract term.
Monitor usage as your primary signal. Live in the product and usage data. Know which accounts are consuming, which are stalling, and which are hitting limits — then act on it before anyone asks you to.
Run high-velocity cycles. Manage a high volume of concurrent, transactional deals without letting anything slip. Multi-thread quickly, get to decision-makers, compress timelines. Identify and de-risk churn early. Spot the leading indicators of a flat or declining account and mobilize the right internal resources to turn it around.
Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Support to remove blockers and land outcomes for customers.
Feed the machine. Bring patterns you see in the field back to Solutions, Product, and Sales. Your book is one of the best sources of signal in the company. Own the full expansion and renewal sales cycle across your book of business, executing a complex, value-based process that spans multiple stakeholders, teams, and use cases within each account.

A growth mindset. You seek out feedback, you're coachable, and you get measurably better every quarter. You'd rather be corrected than comfortable.
Grit. Transactional sales is a volume game with a lot of noise and a lot of no. You stay in it, you follow up again, and you don't get discouraged.
Creativity. Not every deal follows the playbook. You find non-obvious paths to the right stakeholder, non-obvious reasons to expand, and non-obvious ways to unstick a stalled account.
An act-like-an-owner mindset. Nobody has to hand you your priorities. You know your number, you know your book, and you go get it. When something's broken, you fix it or flag it - you don't wait.
A bias toward velocity. You'd rather close a smaller deal this week than a perfect one next quarter. You move fast without being sloppy.
Comfort with technical products and technical buyers. You don't need to be an ML engineer, but you need to be genuinely curious about AI and willing to learn the space deeply enough to be credible with engineering and data science teams.
Data fluency. You can pull, read, and act on usage and consumption data without waiting for someone to build you a dashboard.
Clear communication - written and verbal, with customers and internally.

GitLab's APJ Ecosystem team builds and scales the partner (channel, alliance, and hyperscaler) motion across the region. ASEAN is a strategic market for GitLab, and this hire is central to strengthening our partner ecosystem there — deepening a smaller number of high-value partnerships rather than spreading thin across many transactional ones.

Based in Singapore, our Ecosystem Sales Manager (ESM)- ASEAN, is a senior, market-facing role responsible for building and scaling GitLab's partner business in ASEAN countries across the full breadth of the ecosystem: hyperscalers, large ASEAN-centric system integrators (SIs), and born-in-the-cloud / AI-native partners.

We are looking for someone with the range and seniority to credibly own strategic partner relationships across all of these partner types, and to help grow our business through these partners.
This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who has already built a career scaling partner-sourced and influenced revenue in ASEAN, someone who knows the hyperscaler ecosystem (AWS & GCP), has deep, credible relationships with ASEAN's major SIs, and understands how to engage newer-generation cloud-native and AI partners as they become an increasingly important part of the go-to-market.

Build and scale GitLab's partner-sourced and influence business in ASEAN across hyperscalers, large ASEAN-centric SIs, and born-in-the-cloud/AI partners.
Develop deep, strategic (not transactional) relationships with a focused set of priority partners — joint business plans, QBRs, and named executive sponsorship.
Own hyperscaler relationship management and Marketplace motion with AWS and/OR GCP.
Build and grow relationships with major ASEAN SIs and market-making channel/born-in-the-cloud partners and emerging AI-native partners.
Drive partner-sourced pipeline and bookings, and carry a quota tied to partner-sourced/generated revenue.
Partner closely with the ASEAN sales team to ensure partner-sourced opportunities are properly identified, supported, and closed.
Work with the ASEAN and APJ Ecosystem team to help shape and refine the ASEAN Ecosystem coverage model.
Contribute to partner enablement, certification, and go-to-market programs suited to the ASEAN market.
Report on partner engagement health, pipeline contribution, and progress against strategic-partner milestones.

15+ years of experience in channel/alliance/partner management or ecosystem sales, ideally within enterprise software, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure.
Extensive, well-rounded experience scaling a business through partners across hyperscalers, large ASEAN-centric SIs, and born-in-the-cloud/AI-native partners — not narrowly specialized in just one partner type.
Direct experience managing hyperscaler relationships (AWS & GCP) including Marketplace motion.
A strong, credible existing network among ASEAN's major SIs and cloud-native/channel partners, with a track record of moving relationships from transactional to strategic.
Comfort carrying a partner-sourced revenue quota and being measured on pipeline origination, not just deal closure.
Strong stakeholder management skills — able to align internal sales, marketing, and partner-side stakeholders around joint goals.

Prior experience at or with a hyperscaler (AWS, GCP) in a partner or alliance capacity.
Familiarity with GitLab, DevSecOps, or adjacent developer-tooling ecosystems.
Experience helping design or reset a partner coverage model, comfortable building process rather than only inheriting one.
What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)
Joint business plans and an active engagement cadence (e.g., QBRs) in place across priority hyperscaler, SI, and cloud-native/AI partners.
Demonstrable movement of key partner relationships from transactional to strategic engagement.
Growing partner-sourced pipeline and bookings against quota.
Credible input into finalizing the ASEAN Ecosystem coverage model, grounded in on-the-ground partner relationships.

Why Harvey
At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished.

We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

As a Mid Market Account Executive at Harvey, you will drive the growth and success of our AI solutions within the legal and professional services markets.

As part of the founding Mid Market team in DACH, you will be responsible for establishing and growing relationships with mid-sized law firms and corporate and financial services clients across DACH, understanding their unique challenges, and presenting AI solutions that streamline their processes and boost productivity.

Your ability to articulate the value of Harvey's products, coupled with your passion for groundbreaking AI technologies, will help us shape the future of knowledge work.

Own your book of business by managing a named account list, prioritizing and cultivating inbound leads, and outbounding directly to high-potential prospects.
Manage the full customer lifecycle from prospecting to contracting, onboarding, growing, and renewals.
Achieve and exceed revenue targets and other key sales metrics.
Build strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders, understanding their pain points and aligning Harvey's solutions with their needs.
Conduct high velocity, tailored client evaluations, including product demonstrations and presentations, showcasing the power of Harvey's AI systems to prospects and clients.
Effectively work cross-functionally across the organization to shape Harvey’s solutions to meet customer needs. Collaborate closely with the engineering and product teams to stay updated on the latest AI advancements and tailor solutions to meet client goals.
Develop our sales playbook to enable scaling, documenting learnings that can be applied across accounts.
Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices.
What You Have
Proven track record of selling complex software solutions, with the ability to successfully execute on a consultative, solutions-oriented, value-based selling methodology.
Excited about prospecting, and capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish.
Ability to independently manage a pipeline, accurately forecast key sales performance metrics, and consistently maintain CRM hygiene.
Ability to lead a complex, multi-threaded sale with stakeholders ranging from executives across various functions to day-to-day product users – especially the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated passion for Harvey’s mission and strong understanding of AI and its potential applications in knowledge work. Interest in the legal profession and helping lawyers do their jobs better and more efficiently.
Team player who can collaborate effectively across internal functions (product, legal, etc.) to achieve common goals.
Energized by contributing to the development of our team, sales processes, and culture, refining the value proposition of our solutions and creating sales resources to drive our success.
Fluency in English and German, both spoken and written
Experience working in or adjacent to the Legal industry a plus but not required.

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other.

We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
Role
We are looking for an Account Executive, Enterprise Germany to join our team. This is a remote role, reporting to the Regional Director in the Enterprise department.

In this role, you will drive the strategic expansion of an existing enterprise account portfolio by identifying and winning new use cases across Zscaler's Zero Trust platform — from cloud-native security to AI workload protection.

### **B2B IT\-Distribution \| Fokus Customer Success Management**
Ingram Micro ist der weltweit führende IT\-Distributor. In der Schweiz arbeiten wir mit professionellen B2B\-Partnern, Herstellern und Systemhäusern an nachhaltigem, profitablem Wachstum.
Für diese spezifische Funktion in unserem Sales – Team in Cham suchen wir nicht Einsteiger, sondern eine erfahrene Sales\-Persönlichkeit, idealerweise aus der IT\-Branche.

In dieser Funktion bist du erste Ansprechperson für deine zugeteilten Kunden, erkennst ihre Bedürfnisse frühzeitig und entwickelst passende Lösungen auf Basis unseres Produkt \-und Dienstleistungsportfolios.
Du betreust bestehende Kunden aktiv, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und entwickelst das Geschäft proaktiv weiter. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass Kunden kompetent beraten werden, relevante Angebote erhalten und ihre Anliegen zuverlässig bearbeitet werden.
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Ansprechpartnern aus Vertrieb, Produktmanagement, Vendor Management, Operations und Finance bildest du die Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Herstellern und internen Teams. Du koordinierst Anfragen, erstellst Offerten, begleitest Bestellungen und stellst eine termingerechte sowie professionelle Abwicklung sicher.
Ein weiterer wichtiger Teil deiner Rolle ist die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Kundenbetreuung. Du bringst Ideen zur Prozessoptimierung ein, unterstützt bei der Steigerung von Effizienz und Kundenzufriedenheit und trägst aktiv dazu bei, Kundenbindung, Umsatzentwicklung und Servicequalität nachhaltig zu stärken.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

Join SpaceX as a COMSEC Analyst and take ownership of key COMSEC disciplines that directly support the security of our launch vehicles, satellites, and ground systems. This role offers the opportunity to implement creative security solutions while ensuring national security requirements are met without slowing the pace of innovation.

Independently manage COMSEC accounts, key issuance, and destruction procedures
Perform and oversee self-inspections, inventories, and compliance activities to company standards
Operate, troubleshoot, and configure End Crypto Units including the KG-175 suite, KGR-42, and KG-250 suite
Prepare COMSEC deliverables such as security plans and key management plans with limited oversight
Interface with customer counterparts at the security execution level and present to leadership

Bachelor’s degree; OR 3+ years of professional experience in COMSEC or a security field in lieu of a degree
1+ years of experience in COMSEC or a security field

2+ years of experience with CNSSI 4005 & 4001, NCSM Vol. 2, NSA/CSS Manual 3-16, and related COMSEC policies and procedures
1+ year of experience with systems including International Association of Privacy Professionals (iApp), Key Management Infrastructure (KMI), CARDS, CORE, and Distributed INFOSEC Account System (DIAS)
Experience preparing security deliverables and identifying creative solutions that protect national security
Strong ability to work across departments and interface effectively with customer counterparts
Experience presenting to leadership and determining work priorities independently

Must be willing to work in a classified environment
Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed

This position requires successfully obtaining and maintaining a Top Secret Security Clearance as a condition of employment. While the clearance may not be immediately necessary upon hire, we encourage you to initiate the application process promptly upon accepting this offer.

Your ability to secure the necessary clearance is essential for fulfilling key responsibilities of the role. Should you be unable to obtain it, SpaceX reserves the right to modify or terminate your employment to align with operational needs

Level 1: $85,000.00 - $115,000.00
Level 2: $105,000.00 - $135,000.00
Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.
Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year.

Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Microsoft 365 has become the dominant collaboration platform across Government and Education in Australia. The problem is that it’s inherently driven by the business users. Where information is created, how it’s created, who it gets shared with, how long it remains relevant, and how valuable it is all becomes impossible to manage at scale. Factor AI into the mix, and it can rapidly expose sensitive data and contribute to the rising cost of storage.
It’s a problem all agencies and institutions are looking to solve.
As the Enterprise Account Executive, you are responsible for helping these agencies realise the value of the AvePoint Confidence platform to solve these core problems. You will create, qualify, pitch and close all new revenue from organisations upwards of 2000 employees into Australian Public Sector and Education and manage a portfolio of existing organisations .
Using an account team, it is expected that you will build positive relationships and ensure the successful acquisition of our software to solve our customers’ business problems .
An Enterprise Account Executive’s role is to grow the AvePoint customer base through the development and execution of GTM motions in line with market trends. You will work both directly with and through our channel partners to solve customer problems by leveraging the AvePoint Confidence platform. Additionally, you will be required to maintain (renew) and grow (upsell + cross sell) a group of existing AvePoint customers.

s.t:
Own the full sales cycle: create, qualify, pitch, and close new revenue opportunities with organisations of 2000+ employees.
Build and nurture executive-level relationships to drive adoption of AvePoint solutions.
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies aligned with market trends.
Collaborate with channel partners (SI, VAR, MSPs) to deliver customer value.
Potentially manage renewals and growth (upsell/cross-sell) for existing accounts.

Immunology Account Executives serve as a resource for hospitals, group practices and specialty pharmacies that are focused on treating immunological diseases including rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic disease, atopic dermatitis, and Crohn’s disease.
Responsibilities include learning and development of key account management skills including immunology franchise collaboration and communication, non- branded value based acumen, effective business planning, targeted account execution to deliver measurable impact. Immunology Account Managers provide materials and share data that show both the clinical and economic value treatment as well as positive impact the treatment can have on patient outcomes and organizational goals.

Serve as account manager for assigned geographic location. Locations preferable but not limited to higher base of influential group practices and or limited IDN presence as well as smaller amount of franchise internal business partners.
Lead and drive visible and inclusive portfolio KAM collaboration through consistent communication, follow up and feedback leading to impactful solutions.
Develop of targeted, comprehensive, compliant business and account plans with diversity of input from field partners executing account based resources with high efficiency.
Deliver consistent mastery and execution of immunology portfolio products in key IAE initiatives to drive increased sales and market share.
Provide details on effective disease management and empowering process change using clinical and economic data that impact the treatment of patients across providers in an organization.
Share a variety of tools to help elevate patient support and standardize care, such as clinical pathways, order sets, flow sheets.
Clearly and consistently lead and manage communication (written and verbal) on strategic and tactical insights on target accounts to Immunology District Managers and other internal business partners creating two-way accountability.
Demonstrate perseverance and resiliency to tailor and execute deliverables along call continuum leading to an account’s taking specific action for implementation and impact.
Routinely identify local opportunities and threats and develop/modify business plans accordingly. Partner with IAE and Immunology stakeholders to effectively lead without authority in a complex matrix environment.
Bachelor’s Degree required.
Proven ability to succeed with at least 5 years Immunology franchise or sales or account management experience.
Demonstrated business results by delivering sales numbers for targeted accounts and performance to Field Force Effectiveness measures.
Consistent positive influence and culture of cross-functional collaboration and communication partnerships across functional areas through demonstrated positive stakeholder feedback.
Effective development of business planning, organizational and project management skills, consistently demonstrated with diversity of input from field partners and sales manager.
Proven record of delivering beyond prescriptive selling balancing, organizing and focusing on quality of care and enhanced patient experience on behalf of the patients we serve.
